summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for reseller portal critical path: application->approval->referral->order->commission->payout, plus auth capability messaging and responsive checks.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout did not trigger after 6 invalid attempts in regression suite (expected 429, got 401).

ui_bugs.issue: `open-portal-menu` exists but is not visible/clickable in automation at 768; mobile 390 toggle works.

issues: Sidebar appears expanded; open/close interaction expected by test plan was not consistently available.

action_items: Investigate auth lockout keying (`request.client.host`) behind ingress/proxy so repeated bad logins reliably hit 429 after threshold.
Confirm desired tablet sidebar UX at 768 (always expanded vs toggle behavior) and align automation/data-testid behavior.
Retest unexecuted deep scenarios from request (marketing durable upload validations, payout FAILED reservation release, cancellation/refund reversal adjustments, file-IDOR by direct file fetch).
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout logic depends on client host in throttle key; proxy/gateway host variability can weaken brute-force protection behavior.

Financial chain assertions passed: no ledger before payment; snapshot preserved 10% (1490 paise) after rule superseded to 12%; delivery gate enforced before commission approval; payout PAID required actual_payment_confirmed + reference + non-future date.
Sensitive payout details remained masked in reseller profile responses and privileged patch fields were rejected by validation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Core portal E2E business flow works on production URL with real DB persistence. Use /app/test_reports/portal_iter3_credentials.json for latest QA account + fixture IDs. One auth lockout regression remains reproducible in full suite.
rca of the issue: Repro (lockout): run repeated invalid POST /api/auth/login attempts; expected terminal 429 per policy, observed terminal 401 in full regression run. Probable cause: throttle key includes `request.client.host`, which may vary behind ingress/proxy pathing, preventing stable attempt aggregation.
